purpose: Non-admission discovery of Luxembourg regulator SFCR report directories for life and non-life insurers, with legal entity and solo solvency ratio context complementary to Irish public QRT data; no automated acquisition or model use authorised.

entries.spatial_scope: Luxembourg-authorised regulated undertaking population; domicile is not the location of underlying insured risks
entries.temporal_scope: Live regulator listing observed 2026-11-04, solvency ratio is latest solo annual ratio communicated; actual report year varies by company
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Undertaking name, LEI in parentheses, latest public solo Solvency II ratio, company-specific PDF or SFCR page link where offered
entries.name: Luxembourg CAA public non-life SFCR directory and solo solvency ratios
entries.note: The CAA provider page says its visible population covers direct professional non-life undertakings, explicitly excluding captives and undertakings with a comparable portfolio. Named rows include LEI and latest communicated solo solvency ratio; the ratio is not a published catastrophe AEL/PML, insured TIV or investment/business perimeter, and ratio vintage may differ by carrier. Do not claim this list covers all Luxembourg licensed insurers/reinsurers or all groups. Links may be PDF or company pages; record exact report date, source licence and document rights before acquisition. This is distinct from an EIOPA aggregate or national legal entity register.

entries.note: The official CAA life directory exposes named undertakings and LEIs with latest solo solvency ratios and report links where available. Some companies provide only website links or a contact address rather than a PDF. Do not infer general/non-life insurance or catastrophe property exposures from life company financial ratios; membership and reports have changing dates and potential non-contemporaneous ratios. Raw PDFs, terms, entity/group relationships and reporting vintages require separate verification, and the directory is not a complete actuarial dataset.
